scene: Wide establishing, high three-quarter from the palace hill of Golden Gaya at late-afternoon storm light: foreground, dark blurred giwa roof eaves and a timber post; midground, a young harbour town of thatch and tile and an iron-stacked quay; background, a vast pale sea and, tiny on the far horizon under one cloud-break shaft, a single red sail. Heo's ship is exactly the attached ship_ayuta board: ornate red-and-gold lacquered hull with painted panels, one great crimson battened sail and a small red mizzen. Ignore the board's bright daylight; repaint it in the scene light. Three planes: dark out-of-focus foreground near the lens, the beat sharp in the midground, the background dissolving into sea haze; more than half the frame quiet negative space.
alt: Six years on: Golden Gaya has a timber palace on its hill, a harbour stacked with iron, a market, and on the far horizon one small red speck
